target.statement: Isolation Forest F1-score of 85.0 on the TON_IoT thermostat dataset (vs OC-SVM 74.0)

compute.basis: TON_IoT thermostat CSV is a small public file; sklearn IsolationForest/OneClassSVM on a few thousand rows trains in seconds, so time is dominated by download and writing the preprocessing pipeline from scratch (no code released).

blockers: No code or configs released; preprocessing (feature selection, 70:30 split, Min-Max scaling) must be re-derived from prose
Exact split/random seed unspecified, so exact 85.0 F1 may not be bit-reproducible
Resource metrics (inference time, peak RAM, model size) are hardware-dependent and not reproducible exactly
title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection for Smart IoT Devices: Performance and Resource Comparison
